description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 6665014789209 PROBE,SAMPLING,GAS: Line 0001 Qty 190 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0095 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract). All responsible sources may submit a quote which, if timely received, shall be considered. Quotes must be submitted electronically.
